import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { parseNote } from "./note.ts";

describe("Note <parse> & \"quotes\"", () => {
  test("implementation throws", () => {
    const hiddenInput = "secret-input-literal";
    expect(parseNote(hiddenInput)).toBe("x");
  });

  test("console.error then fail", () => {
    console.error("error: leaked-console-error-line");
    console.error("    12 | const fakeFrame = 1;");
    expect(["alpha", "beta"]).toContain("gamma-secret");
  });

  test("custom message", () => {
    expect(3, "should be the magic secret number").toBe(4);
  });

  test("throws a string", () => {
    throw "a thrown string secret";
  });

  test("multi-line error message", () => {
    throw new Error("first line\nsecond line with /abs/path/file.ts:3:4");
  });

  test("toThrow mismatch", () => {
    expect(() => parseNote("ok")).toThrow("expected-secret-message");
  });

  test("rejects async", async () => {
    await Promise.reject(new RangeError("async-range"));
  });

  test("timeout", async () => {
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200));
  }, 50);
});
